items.title: Fable 5.2 one-shotted my nephew's dream game
items.snippet: Article URL: https://notesbylex.com/fable-5-2-one-shotted-my-nephews-dream-game Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50433659 Points: 82 # Comments: 56
items.summary: The article recounts how an AI tool, Fable 5.2, successfully created a fully functional video game based on a young boy's dream concept in a single attempt. It showcases how recent advances in generative AI are drastically reducing the effort needed to prototype and build software applications. This illustrates a major shift in how non-technical individuals can bring complex digital ideas to life.
key_points: Fable 5.2 successfully generated a customized game from a single natural language request.
Generative AI capabilities are lowering the technical barriers to game development and rapid prototyping.
personalized software creation via AI is becoming accessible to non-engineers and children.

items.title: Exact – a new cross platform UI framework by the Expo team
items.snippet: Article URL: https://github.com/expo/exact Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50433541 Points: 29 # Comments: 13
items.summary: The Expo team has launched Exact, a new cross-platform UI framework hosted on GitHub. The framework aims to simplify user interface development for applications targeting multiple operating systems. It is gaining early traction and discussion within the software developer community on Hacker News.
key_points: Exact is a new cross-platform UI framework created by the Expo team.
The project is open-source and hosted publicly on GitHub.
It targets developers looking to build consistent user interfaces across platforms.

items.title: Hotel giant Wyndham exposed customer data after app security lapse
items.snippet: Exclusive: Wyndham left a hardcoded credential in its customer app, allowing anyone to access customer data. The hotel giant wouldn't say if it has the ability to check for any past unauthorized access.
items.summary: Wyndham Hotels exposed sensitive customer data due to a hardcoded credential left inside its official customer mobile application. The security flaw allowed unauthorized access to private customer information. The hotel giant did not clarify whether it has the logging capabilities required to check for past unauthorized access.
key_points: Wyndham left hardcoded credentials embedded within its customer mobile app.
The flaw potentially enabled anyone to exploit the credentials and access customer data.
The company declined to state if it can detect or audit past unauthorized access.

items.title: Horible public key tricks
items.snippet: Article URL: https://maurycyz.com/projects/badcert/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50434264 Points: 7 # Comments: 1
items.summary: The article explores problematic implementations and edge cases in public key cryptography and digital certificates. It highlights potential security risks and unexpected behaviors resulting from non-standard key manipulation. The findings serve as a technical breakdown of cryptographic anti-patterns and parsing pitfalls.
key_points: Examines unconventional and risky public key cryptographic tricks.
Highlights edge cases and potential vulnerabilities in digital certificate handling.
Provides insights into how flawed public key setups can undermine system security.

items.title: Jensen Huang reportedly engaged a PR firm with a history of handling high-profile sex scandals a year ago
items.snippet: The PR firm was enlisted shortly after an October 2025 New York Times report described Alice Huang's business dealings with Jensen Huang, Wired reported.
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reportedly hired a PR firm known for managing high-profile crisis situations and scandals approximately a year ago. The engagement followed an October 2025 New York Times report that detailed business dealings involving Alice Huang. The story was originally broken by Wired and covered by TechCrunch.
key_points: Jensen Huang reportedly retained a PR firm with a history of handling high-profile scandals.
The hiring occurred shortly after an October 2025 New York Times article about Alice Huang's business dealings with Jensen Huang.
The development focuses on executive public relations management rather than technical AI developments.
